about:
Aspects Furniture International is based in Chino Hills, California. With more than 40 years of experience in the industry, the company has developed a deep understanding of client project needs. Ownership details and founding year are not publicly disclosed.

The company specializes in design, engineering, and manufacturing of custom casegoods, upholstery seating, vanities, and metal furniture. Its engineers translate concepts into AutoCAD drawings, and craftsmen then build the pieces to specification. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

Aspects serves the hospitality and commercial interior design sectors. It has partnered with design firms such as Atwater Inc. Studio to produce furniture for properties including the Hoodoo Moab hotel in Moab, Utah, and the Inn at Saratoga. The company's work contributed to award-winning projects recognized by the Gold Key Awards and Design Et Al awards.

Aspects emphasizes simplifying and streamlining the manufacturing process, on-time delivery, and high-quality output. Its stated goal is to build the client's vision through integrated design, engineering, and production.
